# UPPER BOUNDS ARE THE PYTHON 3.9 FLOOR, NOT A VERSION PREFERENCE. pyproject declares
# `requires-python = ">=3.9"` and the CI matrix runs a 3.9 leg, but pytest 9, jsonschema
# 4.26 and setuptools 84 all declare `requires_python >= 3.10`. Without these caps the
# resolver still does the right thing on 3.9 -- and Dependabot, which reads this file
# with no interpreter in hand, does not: it opened six PRs (#6, #12, #15, #17, #18, #19)
# raising these floors past the 3.9 wall, each of which would have broken that leg.
# Verified 2026-09-05 by resolving this file on python3.9 and by reading requires_python
# from PyPI. Lift each cap in the same change that drops 3.9, not before.
pytest>=7.0,<9
